name: Redmi TV MFTP0
summary: Redmi TV MFTP0 ships with Xiaomi telemetry, startup ads and promoted content. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This Redmi TV runs China-market firmware. It ships with Xiaomi telemetry, quality reports and cloud control, ads, promoted content and shopping, and background services and preloaded apps. A startup ad is one of the things the list removes. Each app on the list has its own switch in the app, so you decide what goes.

The list was applied in two batches, and the owner checked Home and the voice remote after each. States held after standby, and the owner reported no startup ad after a full restart. It has not been lived with for several days. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The stock Xiaomi home screen, which must stay on
notes: Keep the stock Xiaomi home screen on. This firmware only lets certain home screens take over, and the standard one did not.
The network debugging port closes at every restart, so turn it on again in Settings after each power cycle.
Developer mode is unlocked by pressing OK on the product model seven times, and debugging is under Account and Security.

faq.q: Will the voice remote still work on my Redmi TV?
faq.a: Yes. The owner checked the voice remote after each batch.

faq.q: Will it remove the startup ad?
faq.a: Yes. The owner reported no startup ad after a full restart.
Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on in one tap. Nothing is deleted.
